goals: Preserve a player's component-exact organization intent after a physical stack leaves an eligible persistent storage or machine slot.

Apply native insertion permission AND exact reservation admission to manual placement, vanilla QUICK_MOVE, hoppers, sided automation, and QSN without changing extraction, destination order, internal processing, or routing ownership.
Resolve every eligible logical menu slot to one stable block-owned or player-owned reservation holder, its physical local slot, physical stack, real slot count, and native admission result.
Expose a CSR-owned pinned 27-cell shulker panel with exact-slot viewing, reservation editing, insertion, extraction, persistent transient selection, and fail-closed host identity.
Own recognized native secondary-click shulker transfers while preserving vanilla behavior for unrelated clicks, exact reservation ordering, effective capacities, callbacks, and conserved counts.

Preserve accepted C4 storage reservations, exact ghost/zero/marker visuals, public API compatibility for QSN C9 and CCAR C12, component-exact ordinary-item reservations, generic empty portable-container templates, and server-owned specific portable-container identities without external tooltip integration.
scope: Current 0.1.0-canary19 from implementation checkpoint 804f3fe61bbc216d9d33df8d90326f9f1fc0e929 retains C18's host-centered shulker-panel geometry and immediate host-or-panel lifetime exactly. It corrects the server-authoritative PRIMARY cursor publication for a Creative player inventory: Minecraft 26.2 applies ordinary ContainerSynchronizer cursor packets in normal menus but deliberately ignores ClientboundSetCursorItemPacket while CreativeModeInventoryScreen is open, so C19 sends the native full menu-content state only for that exact Creative inventory menu; all other menus retain incremental broadcastChanges. CSR fingerprint metadata follows the authoritative menu/cursor state and safely acknowledges an already-synchronized host. The optional header-decoration provider contract remains independent of CCAR.

While CSR owns Slot A and remains TESTING, a finalized current CSR testing successor normally replaces the preceding CSR candidate through one serialized Test Instance Manager Slot A transition; only a concrete manager preimage, dependency, or physical-safety failure may leave that successor retained but not deployed.

Bind one exact count-one shulker host by screen, menu, menu ID, visible slot index, Slot instance, underlying container slot, explicit Creative player-inventory locator where applicable, and complete SHA-256 ItemStack fingerprint; never search for an equal stack.

Render and hit-test one fixed 176x83 native panel with an unchanged 176x77 upper shulker region plus the same runtime texture's 176x6 bottom frame, 27 physical 18x18 cells, and bottom-left-at-host-center placement clamped only to the viewport. It remains open only while the pointer is over the host or panel; there is no side rail, corridor, grace frame, or pointer-capture lifetime. Right-button drag acts once per newly entered panel cell, preserving native secondary-click transfer semantics and exact reservation rendering.

Keep pointer hover separate from server-authoritative per-player transient selection; select and cycle only occupied cells, migrate only through the exact server-observed host-slot-to-cursor pickup, and clear on stale identity, menu close, or disconnect.

Use one shared deterministic planner for native secondary-click quick insertion and exact-cell panel transfers: occupied compatible merges, matching reserved empties, then unreserved empties; deny nesting, mismatches, full/nonwritable targets, fake slots, and multi-count hosts.

Derive all panel reservation templates and content transactions from live server state; payloads carry only menu/locator/index/action/fingerprint authority, preserve unrelated components and ReservationData, update real owners once, and broadcast legitimate shared viewers.

Remove every CSR production/build/test dependency on Easy Shulker Boxes, Item Interactions, PuzzlesLib, external tooltip lifecycle, @Pseudo fuzs targets, and nested candidate filtering. C9 and earlier external-tooltip work remains historical provenance in CODEX_LOG.md.

Store sparse format-2 reservations per stable physical owner with explicit format-1 migration. Template entries retain count-one ItemStackTemplate behavior; specific portable-container entries retain an identity-free display template plus family and UUID. Requested block entities use only their real local slot range, vanilla and Double Barrels doubles retain two independent 27-slot owners, and the player Ender inventory is one player-owned 27-slot holder.

Support exact vanilla chest and trapped-chest families, barrel, undyed and all 16 dyed shulkers, dispenser, dropper, hopper, furnace, blast furnace, smoker, brewing stand, crafter, and PlayerEnderChestContainer.

Recognize ordinary and all eight unwaxed/waxed copper chest states through the authoritative predicate blockEntity.getType() == BlockEntityTypes.CHEST && BlockEntityTypes.CHEST.isValid(blockEntity.getBlockState()); single and permitted double forms keep exact physical-half ownership across oxidation, scraping, waxing, and unwaxing.

Preserve vanilla chest CompoundContainer ownership mapping and associate the exact optional Double Barrels 54-slot wrapper with its proven main and partner BarrelBlockEntity owners; combined slots 0-26 map to main local 0-26 and 27-53 to partner local 0-26.

Persist Ender Chest reservations on PlayerEnderChestContainer under container_slot_reservations:ender_chest_reservations adjacent to EnderItems, default old player data to empty, and restore the same player-owned holder across the Minecraft 26.2 respawn path independently of keepInventory.

Use a scoped native-admission bypass to query the actual owner's vanilla canPlaceItem policy, retain targeted post-native hooks for furnace-family, brewing, and crafter rules, preserve specialized menu Slot subclasses and callbacks, and never gate internal setItem writes.

Expose only exact supported storage slots in ChestMenu, ShulkerBoxMenu, DispenserMenu, HopperMenu, FurnaceMenu, BlastFurnaceMenu, SmokerMenu, BrewingStandMenu, and CrafterMenu snapshots/actions; player, hotbar, fake, inactive, result-inventory, and foreign slots remain excluded.

Keep getReservation, isReserved, reservationMatches, mayInsert, classify, and every ReservationSlotClass value binary-compatible with accepted CSR C1 consumers and QSN C8; native-non-writable reservations classify NON_WRITABLE and cannot create QSN affinity.

Preserve neutral 0x59FFFFFF alpha-only ghost rendering, the audited premultiplied pipeline, #43362A solely as the Matcha slot background, literal-zero placement/shadow, hover tooltip, reservation-free rendering, DataComponents.CONTAINER integrity, and the exact supplied 1,723-byte 3x3 RGBA marker at itemX + 12, itemY.
Record the user's exact Canary 3 visual observation only as a narrow INCONCLUSIVE result at manager revision 75; it is not a complete C3 matrix pass and supplies no C4 runtime evidence.

Continue to leave Stacks Are Stacks holder-default alignment to Stacks Are Stacks Container Fixes; preserve count-one ItemStackTemplate materialization, component-exact matching, and effective-maximum classification without CSR production linkage or a MAX_STACK_SIZE reservation component.

Bind the exact Canary 5 deployment f12e434a-51c1-4e84-a487-3ebcadbe3d64 / artifact c9551ad6-7a35-4a0e-ac25-af3efeccd86a FAIL at manager revision 86 only to the user's report that Easy Shulker Boxes carried-shulker insertion admitted a mismatched reservation and the reservation remained visible after removal; infer no unrelated row result.
Preserve the historical C5-C9 failures and their exact artifacts as provenance only; Canary 10 is a material successor and does not infer runtime success from controlled validation.

state.milestone: C19 is an ACTIVE, non-deployed CSR successor to accepted C15. It preserves C18's user-observed-good host-centered panel placement and fixes the Creative inventory path where Minecraft 26.2 ignores the ordinary clientbound cursor packet, leaving the real server cursor invisible despite a successful panel transaction. C19 uses native full-content menu synchronization only for that Creative inventory case, keeps incremental synchronization elsewhere, and sends CSR fingerprint metadata after native state. Exact C18 external runtime evidence is narrow: placement was observed good; ordinary PRIMARY panel pickup failed with an invisible/desynchronized cursor stack that the second click reinserted. No Shift-click, RMB drag, reservations, or CCAR lock result is inferred. Clean Java 25 unit, headless Fabric GameTest, and artifact validation passed; no dedicated Workbench or protected gameplay instance was accessed.
